{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "ekzyis",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "reported that fuzzing with afl++ breaks, questioned key erasure behavior, and suggested a configure-time opt-in to avoid honggfuzz warnings"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:4419570555",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "breaks fuzzing with afl++ in OSS-Fuzz due to an assertion failure from argv manipulation",
      "quote": "I think this will break fuzzing with afl++ in OSS-Fuzz. It defines LLVMFuzzerMutate as a symbol here and then crashes here because of argv manipulation.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author implemented fix and replied done",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4419586585", "rc:4442814364"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4442814364",
      "status_by_quote": "Done."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4419573290",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "asks whether erasing the key when FuzzDefaultMutate returns 0 is intended for key mutations",
      "quote": "The key gets erased if FuzzDefaultMutate returns 0 (which is the case for LLVMFuzzerMutate in afl++) . Is that expected to happen in this branch for key mutations?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "reviewer confirmed author's clarification",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4426404831"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4432455324",
      "status_by_quote": "Ah yes, that is my understanding as well"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4460347597",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "consider a configure-time opt-in for custom mutators instead of detecting the engine and rewriting argv, avoiding warnings in honggfuzz",
      "quote": "Claude suggested a configure-time opt-in. Then we wouldn't need to detect the engine and rewrite arguments",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author declined configure-time opt-in due to required infra changes and instead detected libFuzzer runtime",
      "author_replies": ["rc:4468765307"],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4468765307",
      "status_by_quote": "I would not go with a configure-time opt-in because it would require changes on some infra, including OSS-Fuzz."
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
  "notes": "Author replied to ekzyis's suggestion regarding configure-time opt-in, declining it due to infra requirements, and force-pushed changes detecting the libFuzzer runtime directly.",
  "waiting_on": [
